notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing my game on Steam Demo Fest and filling out the form or making a video.
I'm glad most people liked it. It really helps with development. ❤️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046469/1d819b6eb8762bb2fee067e177ebd20c022e8bcc.jpg"]

Update changes:

Door colliders are turned off during opening, so as not to push the player

Removed the "pile" at the start so that it does not seem that the player is too tall

The scene in the elevator has been reconfigured so as not to warn in advance

The red TV timings have been reconfigured and changed sound

Added a turn of the player in the right direction to the scene in the elevator and the tumbler outside the window, it does not block the controls, but will help not to miss important things

You can now spin the disk on the floor while standing and spin on it if you stand on it

The Kamaz now makes noise only if you lift the photo

If you look closely, you can see a bear at the start of the demo

The refrigerator is not so empty where the hint is

The statue of a wooden gnome, fixed the rotation pivot

Matches now burn a few seconds longer

Removed the music in the credits and just inserted my guitar

There is now soda on the shelf. And from the top right one 4 packs fall out



The demo is just a small part of the game. I'm off to make the full version 🙂

To not miss the game's release, join the discord https://discord.gg/mPF4R5TjVg and add it to your wishlist.
